subject: Intermittent generation truncation detected — customer notification and follow-up
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@greenfield-labs.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent generation truncation detected — looking into it

Hi Samira —

Thanks for flagging the truncated responses this morning. We see a small subset of requests from Greenfield Labs (your API key ending in -GF12) returning abrupt mid-generation stops for long outputs. I wanted to confirm we have you on our radar and to share initial mitigations we're applying.

What we have so far:
- Scope: ~0.4% of requests for your workspace between 07:50–09:05 PDT.
- Symptom: model stream closes mid-token / final paragraph missing. No corrupted tokens, just early termination.
- Short-term mitigation: we've enabled conservative prefix caching and increased the per-request token ceiling for your key.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you share two representative request IDs or example prompts where you saw truncation? That will help us match traces.
2) Are you seeing truncation across multiple models or only the recent rdx-1.3 endpoint?

I'll keep you posted via this thread and update the status page with a short advisory. Apologies for the disruption — we realize long-form outputs are important for your use case.

— Diego Fernandez
Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachment: request-log-snippet.txt (small anonymized trace)
From: Samira Khan <samira@greenfield-labs.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2025 09:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent generation truncation detected — looking into it

Thanks Diego —

Confirmed. Two examples attached below (I’ve pasted shortened inputs inline):
- req-gt-87234: prompt about clinical summary -> result cuts off mid-sentence after ~1200 tokens
- req-gt-87910: batch summarization job -> final item truncated in the middle of paragraph

We only use rdx-1.3 in prod. This started showing up right after last Tuesday’s model refresh; we rolled a hotfix to our retry logic but still see failures intermittently.

We appreciate the quick response. Please let us know any ETA for a full fix and if you need more logs.

— Samira
Senior ML Engineer, Greenfield Labs
samira@greenfield-labs.com
From: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@greenfield-labs.com>, Thomas Lee <tom.lee@greenfield-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2025 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Intermittent generation truncation detected — customer impact and statuspage update request

Team —

Forwarding Greenfield’s examples. Impact is low volume but high-severity for their long-form generation flows. Ask: can Platform/Ops prioritize a triage for possible early-termination path in the rdx-1.3 serving pipeline? Initial hunch is an interaction between our streaming flush logic and KV-cache eviction on certain token boundary patterns.

What I’ve done so far:
- Elevated the key to a throttle-exempt routing for their workspace to avoid mid-flight preemption.
- Pushed a short advisory to the status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2025-09-14-GEN-TRUNC-01 (draft).
- Attached a sanitized trace slice (request-log-snippet.txt) and a screenshot of the advisory draft.

Immediate needs:
- Marissa: can you pull p95/p99 termination events for rdx-1.3 between 07:30–12:00 PDT and correlate with cache-eviction logs?
- Evelyn: can you validate whether last-week model roll introduced any tokenization or eos-handling changes in the build?
- Laura: if we confirm a regression, we should prepare a targeted rollback plan and customer comms.

Samira/Thomas — I’ll update this thread as we have investigator notes. If you want a voice bridge, I can set up a quick call.

Thanks,
Diego
Customer Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: request-log-snippet.txt, statuspage-screenshot-annotated.png
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego@redwood.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.com, evelyn_hart@redwood.com
Cc: Samira Khan <samira@greenfield-labs.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2025 12:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Intermittent generation truncation detected — customer impact and statuspage update request

Thanks Diego — quick update from triage: 

Findings (initial):
- Root cause: a recent change to our stream-flush heuristic introduced an off-by-one where, on particular token boundary sequences, the runtime emitted an end-of-stream prematurely when prefix-KV eviction coincided with a buffer flush.
- Scope: ~0.35% of rdx-1.3 requests in the US region during the window; primarily long-form outputs >800 tokens.
- Fix: we have a two-step plan — (A) immediate server-side rollback of the heuristic for rdx-1.3 (started at 12:15 PDT), (B) safe patch to correct boundary detection and add a unit test covering eviction/flush ordering.

Customer comms plan:
- Short-term: keep the status page advisory live and add ETA for mitigation (rolling rollback started; expected effect within 30 minutes).
- Follow-up: send a postmortem to Greenfield and publish a short incident summary on the status page once we’ve validated.

Diego — thanks for the traces; Marissa and Evelyn, please coordinate on a targeted test suite and confirm rollback complete time. Samira, we’ll mark impacted requests for replay and share a postmortem draft by EOD. Apologies again for the disruption.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference
